title: Local top-K mixture of experts
summary: Probe four local SwiGLU experts with top-2 routing and auxiliary balancing in a single editable model configuration.

steps.explanation: Token activations are flattened, routed to top-K experts, dispatched through selected SwiGLUs, and combined with normalized router weights.
observe: first eight selected expert indices and normalized weights in a full probe diagnostic

prerequisites: Prepare the selected tokenizer only for an initialized probe; prepare data before training.
try_changes: Predict K selected experts per token and verify normalized weights in a probe.
Change top-2 to top-1, then separately change auxiliary loss from .01 to 0.
Inspect expert counts before inferring active versus optimizer storage.
limits: Router behavior and total optimizer state change with expert count; this lesson makes no equal-FLOP or throughput claim.
The controlled research recipe uses auxiliary coefficient 0, which is intentionally distinct from this teachable lesson.

papers.title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
papers.claim_boundary: Switch motivates conditional-capacity questions; this small local top-K implementation is not a reproduction of Switch training or systems results.
